title: Automated Item Neutralization for Non-Cognitive Scales: A Large Language Model Approach to Reducing Social-Desirability Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Rewriting personality assessment items (IPIP-BFM-50) using an LLM to neutralize evaluative language, and comparing the correlations of participant responses on the original versus neutralized items with the Marlowe-Crowne Social Desirability Scale (MC-SDS).
